title: disappearing-messages/1.0/timer
description: Sets or clears the conversation's disappearing-message timer. Messages sent afterwards carry expires_time = created_time + seconds; messages already sent are unaffected.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender; the same id goes to every member of a group.

from.description: Sender DID. Always present: these messages are sent authenticated, and the envelope, not the body, says who sent them.

pthid.description: In a group conversation, the group's id. Absent in a pair.

created_time.description: UTC epoch seconds. Of the timers set for one conversation, the one with the latest value stands; on a tie, the shorter.

seconds.description: A positive integer: messages sent from now on are removed this many seconds after they are sent. 0 or null: the timer is cleared.
